items.title: Vertex Pharmaceuticals earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Vertex Pharmaceuticals (VRTX) rose about 1.2% pre-market to $560 as of Nov 3, 9:27 AM EST. It then reversed. At 12:50 PM EST the stock was at $533.24 (-3.60%), below the prior close of $553.15. Analysts mostly raised price targets, so the selloff looks like profit-taking near the 52-week high of $568.67 rather than a rejection of the results.
